_comment: Loaded automatically by Program.cs's existing AddJsonFile($appsettings.{Environment}.json) chain when DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=Certification (see docs/certification-harness.md). No host/URL values here — those are injected as AUTOMATION_AGENT_Portal__* environment variables by Certification.Cli at launch time, never hardcoded (item 10).
_capacity_comment: BrowserPoolSize/InteractivePoolSize eram 0 nesta config - WindowsCapabilityDetector.cs le esses valores direto e marca agent.browser_execution/agent.interactive_execution como NotConfigured quando o pool e 0 (nao Available), entao AdmissionController.EvaluateAsync SEMPRE rejeitava qualquer automacao browser_playwright ou python_desktop com INTERACTIVE_CAPABILITY_NOT_AVAILABLE antes mesmo de tentar lancar o processo - nao era so falta de runtime, era a propria capacidade declarada como indisponivel neste appsettings. Subido para 1 para o Agent de certificacao ficar apto a aceitar navegador (Playwright) e automacao de aplicativo visivel/interativa de verdade.
